en.headline: Victoria Park lantern street queues closed at 10pm on Mid-Autumn night
en.dek: The Tourism Board shut the World Lantern Street waiting area at 10pm on Friday after large crowds, citing public safety and order.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board closed the waiting area for the World Lantern Street at Victoria Park at 10pm on Mid-Autumn Festival night, saying visitor numbers had become too high to keep admitting people safely.

The board said in a late-evening notice that the Causeway Bay entrance queue would stop at 10pm and that there would be no further admission to that display after the cutoff. Television and newspaper reports described long queues stretching onto the park lawn well before lighting time, with some visitors waiting more than half an hour.

The International Lantern Spectacular, staged with the Leisure and Cultural Services Department Mid-Autumn lantern carnival in the same park, has drawn heavy crowds since it opened. Organisers had already extended nightly lighting to midnight from 24 to 27 September and prolonged the exhibition to 4 October.

The Tourism Board had earlier said crowd-control measures, including an earlier stop to queuing, would be used when needed. The wider park lantern displays continued after the World Lantern Street cutoff. The Tai Hang fire dragon also entered the park later on Friday night as part of the festival programme.

zh.headline: 中秋夜維園世界網燈大街晚上十時截龍
zh.dek: 旅發局因人流眾多，周五晚上十時關閉銅鑼灣入口等候區，停止再排隊進入該展區，指為保障公眾安全及秩序。
body: 香港旅遊發展局中秋節當晚因參觀人流眾多，於晚上十時關閉維多利亞公園「世界網燈大街」銅鑼灣入口等候區，停止再排隊進入該展區。
旅發局晚間公布，安排出於公眾安全及維持秩序的考慮。電視及報章報道指，亮燈前公園草地已出現長龍，部分市民輪候逾半小時。
旅發局與康樂及文化事務署在維園同期舉辦的「國際中秋網燈匯」及中秋網燈會，開幕以來持續吸引大批市民及旅客。主辦單位早前已將9月24日至27日亮燈時間延長至午夜十二時，並將展期延至10月4日。
旅發局早前亦表示，會視乎人流實施管制，包括提早停止排隊。截龍後，園內其他網燈展覽仍繼續開放。大坑舞火龍周五晚稍後亦按原定節目巡遊至維園。
